text:
Artificial intelligence is changing modern education by enabling learning experiences to be adapted to individual students. Traditional classrooms often require teachers to deliver the same material at the same pace, even though students differ in their prior knowledge, learning speed, and academic needs. AI-supported learning systems provide an alternative by analysing student performance and adjusting educational content accordingly.

One major advantage of AI is its ability to identify patterns in student learning. An intelligent tutoring system can detect repeated errors, recognise areas of weakness, and recommend suitable exercises. A student who struggles with algebra, for example, may receive additional explanations and simpler practice questions, while a more advanced student may be given complex problems. This approach can prevent weaker students from falling behind and reduce boredom among faster learners.

AI can also provide immediate feedback. In large classes, teachers may not be able to review every exercise as soon as it is completed. AI-powered platforms can evaluate certain types of work, explain mistakes, and suggest corrective steps. Timely feedback helps students understand problems before misconceptions become firmly established.

However, personalised learning should not be treated as a complete replacement for human teaching. AI systems may interpret measurable performance accurately while failing to understand emotional distress, family difficulties, or a student’s loss of confidence. Excessive dependence on automated recommendations may also reduce opportunities for discussion, collaboration, and independent exploration.

AI has the potential to make education more responsive to individual learning needs. Its greatest value lies in supporting teachers with detailed information, adaptive materials, and faster feedback. Nevertheless, effective personalised learning requires human judgement to ensure that educational decisions remain sensitive, balanced, and focused on the student as a whole.
